episodeTitle.en: Unorthodox frameworks for growing your product, career, and impact | Bangaly Kaba (YT, IG, FB)
episodeTitle.zh: 《增长你的产品、职业和影响力的非传统框架 | 班加利·卡巴（YouTube、Instagram、Facebook）》

guestBioOfficial.en: Bangaly Kaba was an early growth PM at Facebook, head of growth at Instagram, and VP of Product at Instacart and is currently Director of Product at YouTube overseeing a global team working on creator monetization. Bangaly has also been a growth advisor to dozens of companies, including Twitter, on the board of multiple companies, and is an active angel investor. In our conversation, we discuss: • A simple framework for choosing where to work and what to work on
guestBioOfficial.zh:
班加利·卡巴（Bangaly Kaba）曾在Facebook担任早期增长产品经理，在Instagram担任增长主管，并在Instacart担任产品副总裁，目前在YouTube担任产品总监，负责监督全球团队的创作者变现工作。班加利还为Twitter等数十家公司提供增长咨询，担任多家公司的董事会成员，并且是一位活跃的天使投资人。在我们的对话中，我们将讨论：  
• 选择工作地点和工作内容的简单框架

title.en: Unorthodox frameworks for growing your product, career, and impact | Bangaly Kaba (YT, IG, FB)
title.zh: 《增长你的产品、职业和影响力的非传统框架 | 班加利·卡巴（YouTube、Instagram、Facebook）》

summary.en: Bangaly shares a five-component change framework—vision, skills, incentives, resources, action plan—and the discipline of truly understanding a problem before justifying and executing on it. He discusses his legendary “How to Choose Where to Work” essay and how impact depends on the environment and your skills. The conversation is packed with lessons on growth, culture, and making real change inside large organizations.
summary.zh: Bangaly 分享了一个五要素变革框架——愿景、技能、激励、资源、行动计划——以及“先真正理解问题，再论证和执行”的纪律。他谈到了那篇传奇的《如何选择工作与方向》文章，以及影响力如何取决于环境与个人技能。对话充满了关于增长、文化和在大型组织内产生真正变革的洞见。
